tasks.title: API adopts the contract patch and rejects invalid notify channels and reports
tasks.spec: ## Repository: api, R7, all Tests and Completion evidence; Rollout steps 1-2; Security impact; Acceptance evidence 5. After the contract child merges, pin its full main merge SHA implementing R1-R6 (2.5.1 or the next free patch) and regenerate bun.lock. First add the three defect regressions and the emoji accept control to the existing real-server port-0 suite and run on the old c5ce6685ce8b563a243823bca451032291b81adb pin. The three reject cases fail by assertion, the control passes. Assert the clientName error literal and unchanged storage, revision and audit on rejection. No API production-source change. Include full checks, pin verification and PR evidence.

acceptance.expected: After the bump, 0 fail: POST /admin/notify/channels with pulse_console answers 422 and channel.smtp.clientName: must be a host name, preserving storage/revision/audit; a trailing-text from address answers 422; PUT /service/notify/report rejects 101 emoji in fileChannels[0].refs[0] with 422 and accepts 100 with 204. On the old 2.4.0 pin the three reject assertions fail with actual 201, 201 and 204; the 100-emoji control passes with 204 on both pins. A focused run's global coverage exit status is not its test result.
exit 0; the manifest and committed lockfile agree.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and full tests pass; the existing 80% line coverage gate passes.

The manifest and lockfile workspace dependency contain the same full 40-character patch merge SHA, independently obtained from the merged contract child PR on main (R1-R6, version 2.5.1 or the next free patch literal named there); the lockfile resolution matches that commit.
With CONTRACT_PATCH_SHA set to the full merge SHA from the contract child PR, status is ahead or identical: the pinned patch commit is on contract main.
Before committing, only package.json, bun.lock and src/server.notify-channels.test.ts are changed or untracked.
exit 0; required API CI checks pass.

Records the three old-pin assertion failures, the passing control on both pins and the new-pin 422/204 results; the independently verified full main patch merge SHA and matching lockfile; bun run check and CI results; the applicable Security impact dependency-pin/input-validation review. Includes the AGENTS.md startup/manual HTTP check command and result for changed user-visible validation.
